name: Kuroi Shin
source:
A cat that lives on the outskirts of the village in a western styled house. He has a slender and handsome figure, perfect reflexes, and gets good grades, but he has poor physical strength. He can be a little stuck up. He has asthma. He makes sweets to keep his mind off things whenever he feels down.

[From [url=http://en.wikifur.com/wiki/Morenatsu]Wikifur[/url] and [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/Morenatsu]TV Tropes[/url]]
